content.value_statement: FastAPI teams need consistent routers with clear authentication, response models, and status codes. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through repeatable router scaffolding.
actual_capabilities: Guides creation of FastAPI routers for REST API resources.
Shows optional and required authentication dependency patterns.
Explains response_model usage for item and list endpoints.
Recommends HTTP 201 and 204 status codes for create and delete routes.
Lists integration steps for routers, main app mounting, models, services, and frontend API functions.
Defines placeholder names for PascalCase resources, snake_case resources, and plural route labels.
limitations: The referenced assets/template.py file is not included in this package.
It does not create database models, migrations, or service implementations by itself.
It does not validate application-specific authorization rules or business logic.
It assumes an existing FastAPI project structure and authentication helpers.

use_cases.title: Add CRUD endpoints
use_cases.description: Create a new resource router with list, detail, create, update, and delete endpoints.

use_cases.title: Standardize API routes
use_cases.description: Align router structure, response models, authentication choices, and status codes across a FastAPI service.

use_cases.title: Connect backend and frontend work
use_cases.description: Plan router registration, Pydantic models, service hooks, and frontend API functions for one feature.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic router
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new resource.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a FastAPI router for the Project resource. Include standard CRUD endpoints, response models, and route names.

prompt_templates.title: Add authentication rules
prompt_templates.scenario: Apply optional or required user dependencies.
prompt_templates.prompt: Update this FastAPI router plan so read endpoints allow optional authentication and write endpoints require authentication.

prompt_templates.title: Review response behavior
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this FastAPI router design for response models, list return types, create status codes, and delete status codes.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor an existing module
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced migration into a project structure.
prompt_templates.prompt: Refactor these existing FastAPI endpoints into a resource router. Include mount steps, model updates, service boundaries, and frontend API tasks.

output_examples.input: Create a Projects router with list, retrieve, create, update, and delete endpoints.
output_examples.output: A router plan with endpoint names, response model choices, authentication decisions, expected status codes, and integration tasks.

output_examples.input: Review this Orders router before I add it to the main app.
output_examples.output: A checklist of missing response models, inconsistent status codes, authentication gaps, and router registration steps.

output_examples.input: Plan backend and frontend API work for a new Comments resource.
output_examples.output: A feature implementation outline covering router paths, Pydantic models, service layer needs, and frontend API function names.

best_practices: Define the resource name, route path, and plural label before generating endpoints.
Choose optional or required authentication per route based on data exposure.
Register the router in the main app and align Pydantic models with service returns.
anti_patterns: Do not copy generic CRUD routes without checking authorization per operation.
Do not omit response models because inconsistent API contracts become hard to test.
Do not assume create and delete routes share the same status codes or response bodies.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps create FastAPI routers for REST resources with CRUD patterns, authentication dependencies, response models, and status codes.

faq.question: Can it add authentication patterns?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows optional authentication for public reads and required authentication for protected operations.

faq.question: Does it include a ready-to-copy template file?
faq.answer: No. The instructions mention assets/template.py, but this package only includes SKILL.md.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report marks it as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it design my database layer?
faq.answer: No. It can plan service boundaries, but database schemas, migrations, and ORM details need project-specific work.

faq.question: How should I use it in an existing project?
faq.answer: Provide the resource name, existing auth helpers, model names, target routes, and any service layer requirements.
